issues.display_title: Issue #4303: feat(maps-javascript): display status, used in, and key usage modal with tour detail links
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add Status and Used In columns to the Maps JavaScript API key management table (/profile/map-javascript), and implement a dedicated modal (KeyUsageModal) with search and pagination to inspect virtual tours utilizing each key.

📌 Branch & Current Progress

  • Working Branch: explore/gsv-virtual-tour-key
  • Base Branch: origin/development
  • Current Status:
    • ✅ UI & Prototype Completed: Implemented the two new columns (Status & Used In), modal view (KeyUsageModal), icon-only navigation button with tooltip redirecting to Virtual Tour Manager (/my-tours/:mid/hosted?tour_key=:tour_key), real-time search, and pagination (backed by structured mock/static data ready for PM presentation).
    • ✅ Testing & Code Quality: 11 unit tests in src/pages/Profile/MapsJavascript/MapsJavascript.test.jsx pass 100%, ESLint & Prettier are completely clean.
    • ⏳ Next Step (Hand-off): Wire up to live backend endpoints once BE tasks (#1912 & #1914) are completed.

Requirements

1. Table Columns on /profile/map-javascript

  • Status:
    • In Use (success badge): For active global keys or tour keys assigned to 1+ virtual tours.
    • Unused (neutral badge): For tour keys not assigned to any virtual tour.
  • Used In:
    • Global Keys: Shows button/badge All Virtual Tours (Global Default).
    • Tour Keys: Shows a clickable count button (e.g. 3 Tours) opening the KeyUsageModal.
    • Unused Keys: Shows - (None).

2. Key Usage Modal (KeyUsageModal)

  • Global Key View:
    • Informative summary banner explaining global scope and fallback behavior across all Google Street View tours.
    • Shortcut action button Browse My Tours linking directly to /my-tours.
  • Tour Key View:
    • Lists virtual tours using this key (name, mid, tour_key).
    • Search input filtering tours by name, MID, or tour key.
    • Pagination (5 tours / page).
    • Icon-only button with tooltip (View Tour Detail) that navigates to: 
      navigate(`/my-tours/${tour.mid}/hosted?tour_key=${tour.tour_key}`)

Modified Files on Branch

  • src/pages/Profile/MapsJavascript/MapsJavascript.jsx
  • src/pages/Profile/MapsJavascript/Components/KeyUsageModal.jsx (new component)
  • src/pages/Profile/MapsJavascript/Components/index.js
  • src/pages/Profile/MapsJavascript/MapsJavascript.test.jsx
  • src/locales/en.json

Acceptance Criteria

  • Table displays Status and Used In columns properly.
  • Main table search bar supports filtering by key name, key string, status, and tour names.
  • Modal opens properly for both global and tour-specific keys.
  • In-modal search and pagination work smoothly.
  • View Tour Detail button (icon-only + tooltip) navigates to Virtual Tour Manager passing tour_key.
  • 11 unit tests passing and ESLint compliant.
  • Connect with real backend API endpoints (Issues GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1912 & GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1914).
